info.name: PDF actions
info.summary: Extract, split, combine, OCR and check PDFs from the Files context menu, powered by PdfCraft
info.description:
Adds a "PDF tools" submenu to the Files app:
* Extract pages, split, rotate/delete pages, edit title and author * Combine several PDFs into one * Extract text, check redactions for hidden text * Make PDFs searchable (OCR) and optimize file size as background jobs
Requires the `pdfcraft-cli` binary on the server (https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft).
